title: EVENTTHING Venue Library — hotels.public.csv
description: One record of `data/hotels.public.csv` (3,038 rows, 23 columns). Empty CSV cells are `null`; numbers are stored as CSV text and MUST be coerced before validation. Encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF. See `fields.md`.

id.title: id
id.description: Unique record ID. Prefix: ACC-* Accor, MAR-* Marriott, SHL-* Shangri-La, WYN-* Wyndham, HIL-* Hilton, IHG-* IHG. Primary key.

slug.title: slug
slug.description: URL-safe identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; unique within the file.

name_zh.title: name_zh
name_zh.description: Chinese property name as published by the hotel; blank when the source publishes no Chinese name — never machine-translated.

name_en.title: name_en
name_en.description: English property name as currently used on the official site; blank when the source publishes none.

venue_type.title: venue_type
venue_type.description: Always `酒店会议设施` (hotel with meeting facilities) in this file.

brand_group.title: brand_group
brand_group.description: Brand group: Accor / Marriott / Shangri-La / Hilton Worldwide / Wyndham Hotels & Resorts / IHG.

brand.title: brand
brand.description: Brand within the group (e.g. Novotel, W Hotels); official spelling kept.

star_rating.title: star_rating
star_rating.description: 4 or 5. Only 4–5 star properties are published; 3-star records stay in the internal master as denominator data.

country.title: country
country.description: Country or territory in English; Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan are recorded separately.

country_zh.title: country_zh
country_zh.description: Country or territory in Chinese; blank when no official Chinese name.

city.title: city
city.description: City in English, as given by the official page or a public gazetteer.

city_zh.title: city_zh
city_zh.description: City in Chinese, as given on the official page.

address_en.title: address_en
address_en.description: Street address in English as published; blank when not published.

lng.title: lng
lng.description: Longitude, WGS-84 (EPSG:4326). Recorded only when published by the source; never inferred. Bounds: -180 to 180.

lat.title: lat
lat.description: Latitude, WGS-84. Recorded only when published by the source; never inferred. Bounds: -90 to 90.

geo_precision.title: geo_precision
geo_precision.description: `venue` = property-level point; `city_only` = city known, coordinates withheld; `none` = no coordinates.

website.title: website
website.description: URL of the hotel's official page.

license.title: license
license.description: Data licence: `CC-BY-4.0`; credit EVENTTHING Venue Library.

opening_year.title: opening_year
opening_year.description: Four-digit opening year as published; blank when not published.

status.title: status
status.description: Operating status. One of `open`, `closed`, `renovating`, `under_construction`, `unknown`. See “Status model”.

status_asof.title: status_asof
status_asof.description: Date of the evidence behind `status`, YYYY-MM-DD.
